prompts.text: Raise both arms straight up above the head, palms facing forward
Extend both forearms slightly forward with palms facing up, in an explanatory gesture
While standing in place, a person raises both arms straight upward until both hands are above the head.
While standing in place, a person extends both forearms forward, turning both palms upward as if explaining something.

hands.forwardMeasurementConvention: Left, right order; Core27 chest-local +Z is forward; displacement is relative to the first generated frame, not the input history.

results.limitations: Source Core27 geometry; hand-side and height diagnostics are not human naturalness or target-avatar collision judgments.

semanticEvaluation.assessment: Both wrists above the head is a necessary diagnostic for this command; it does not establish full pose, palm orientation or naturalness.

projection.rootHeightSource: negative minimum neutral foot/toe Y relative to Hips; synthetic support plane Y=0
projection.lowerBody: synthetic neutral Core27 legs with pelvis above the source foot/toe support plane; not observed Unity legs
projection.footContacts: ARDY source-FK height/velocity heuristic on synthetic stationary feet

provenance.allocator_warmup: disabled unnecessary model-sized preallocation during adapter load
provenance.loading_io: sequential exact tensor copy with per-tensor safetensors mapping release
provenance.placement_only_change: Official factory and encode(batch_size=1), direct full-CUDA construction

limitations: Four specific prompts and two fixed seeds, not a broad validation of motion-following quality.
Offline teacher vectors are an ablation only; production still uses a single Qwen model.
